answer: Farming becomes a quartz bet on surviving 94 epochs of grading, and every ember settlement recomputes the jade schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 94 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
